conventions.convention: Countable Choice is adopted. Spatial measure is the completed, unnormalised pushforward of Lebesgue measure on the half-open fundamental cell; velocity and time use Lebesgue measure.
The dimensionless weight is ω_k(v)=Σ_{j=0}^k(|v|/v_*)^j with v_*=1 metre per second. The density counts particles; ρ=mn. Mean velocity requires n>0, and the Maxwellian requires positive temperature.

The weak collision identity has factor 1/4, incoming product A, outgoing product B, and bracket δφ=φ(v)+φ(w)−φ(v′)−φ(w′). Its right side is the integral of (B−A)δφ. Required tests belong to a declared testing subspace and satisfy absolute convergence.
Collision symmetry is an adopted hypothesis. Full support means every nonempty relatively open subset of the elastic collision set has positive measure; symmetry alone does not imply full support.
H uses log(f/f_ref) with a constant positive reference density of matching units. The production D is nonnegative and the local balance is ∂_t h+div J_H=−D.

BGK uses the moment-matched Maxwellian and Q_BGK(f)=(M[f]−f)/τ on the declared positive-density, positive-variance domain. The accelerated homogeneous equation divides this operator by dimensionless ε.

Euler passage assumes degree-three weighted spacetime convergence and degree-two weighted initial convergence to a local Maxwellian with C1 limiting fields, bounded velocity, and density and temperature bounded above and away from zero.

load_bearing.statement: For each declared input f and test φ in S_f, both sides converge absolutely and ∫φQ_ν(f)dv=(1/4)∫(B−A)δφ dν. S_f contains every compactly supported smooth complex velocity test; moment and entropy results additionally require their specified polynomial and logarithmic tests.
For n,T,m,k_B>0 and u∈R³, M=n(2πθ)^(−3/2)exp(−|v−u|²/(2θ)), θ=k_BT/m, has number moment n, momentum moment nu, pressure tensor nk_BT I₃, zero centered heat flux, and energy mn|u|²/2+3nk_BT/2.

For the positive periodic C1 kinetic solution with the stated derivative envelopes, finite absolute third moments, local weighted spacetime integrability, and admissible collision-invariant tests, the exact balances are ∂_tρ+div(ρu)=0, ∂_t(ρu)+div(ρu⊗u+P)=0, and ∂_tE+div(Eu+Pu+q)=0.

For the stated finite-valued nonnegative initial density with finite weighted third moment, positive density and centered second moment, and finite absolute reference-relative entropy, f^ε(t)=M+exp(−t/(ετ))(f₀−M) is the unique nonnegative C1 weighted-L1 solution with positive density and temperature. It preserves the defining moments, has weighted distance exp(−t/(ετ)) times the initial distance, and integrated distance at most ετ times that distance.

Under the stated positive periodic regularity, entropy and derivative envelopes, local spacetime integrability, measurable locally integrable production with integrable spatial sections, adopted kinetic equation, and absolutely convergent tests 1 and log(f/f_ref), the local distributional balance is ∂_t h+div J_H=−D, D≥0, and H is differentiable with H′(t)=−D_tot(t)≤0.

For the stated regular positive scaled kinetic solutions with admissible invariant tests and derivative envelopes, assumed degree-three weighted spacetime convergence and degree-two weighted initial convergence to M_{n,u,T}, with the stated C1 positive bounded limiting fields, imply the compressible monatomic Euler equations, their initial-trace weak identities, and pointwise equations in the open time slab.
Under the homogeneous BGK theorem's initial-data hypotheses, for every t≥0, 0≤H(f^ε(t))−H(M)≤exp(−t/(ετ))(H(f₀)−H(M)).
